q: Take the muddy page to Commander Ebonlocke.
Give the cask of Evershine to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.
Bring 10 Ghoul Fangs, 10 Skeleton Fingers and 5 Vials of Spider Venom to Madame Eva in Darkshire.
Farmer Furlbrow wants you to retrieve his pocket watch from the wardrobe in his farmhouse at the pumpkin farm to the West.
Protect Corporal Keeshan on the journey back to Redridge.
Kill Stalvan Mistmantle and show Madame Eva his family ring.
Sten Stoutarm would like 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat.
Kill Lord Melenas and bring his head to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
Kill 12 Kobold Laborers, then return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey.
The Disarming Mixture seemed to take effect. Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir to report the good news.
Bring Executor Arren 12 Scarlet Armbands from Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates.
Bring 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings to Deathguard Burgess in Brill.
Protect Corporal Keeshan on the journey back to Redridge.
Bring the Mudsnout Mixture, a Strong Troll's Blood Potion, 5 Daggerspine Scales and 5 Torn Fin Eyes to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill Sin'Dall and return with her paw.
Bring 12 samples of Zanzil's Mixture to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
Bring Kenata, Fardel, and Marcel Dabyrie's Heads to Genavie Callow in Undercity.
Gather Searing Collars from the cultists in Skull Rock.
Find someone who knows of Ghost Howl.
Bring the Heart of Isha Awak to Mahren Skyseer.
Bring the Filled Vessel to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.
Sten Stoutarm would like 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat.
Travel to Falfindel Waywarder on the border of Thousand Needles and Feralas.
Bring the Filled Soul Gem to Nimboya.
Find the Tablet of Will, and return them to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.
Slay Lord Azrethoc and Jugkar Grim'rod and return to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
Bring a Kor Gem to Thundris Windweaver in Darkshore.
Locate Zzarc'Vul in the southern ogre mound in Duskwood and return his monocle to Viktori in Darkshire.
Bring 6 Thick Armor Kits and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
Bring 6 Thick Armor Kits and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
Bring the Tiara of the Deep to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
Retrieve the Relics of Wakening and bring them to Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar.
Read Baelog's Journal, explore the hidden chamber, then report to Prospector Stormpike.
Fight to the top of Jintha'Alor, kill Vile Priestess Hexx for the key to Sharpbeak's cage, and save Sharpbeak.
Escort Dalinda Malem from Thunder Axe Fortress and then return to Vahlarriel Demonslayer in Desolace.
Bring the head of Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle to Brave Windfeather in Red Cloud Mesa.
Open the chest and claim your reward.
Return Tymor's Drawing Kit to him in Ironforge.

Destroy Razelikh the Defiler and return the Severed Horn of the Defiler to the Fallen Hero of the Horde. You will also need to return the Ward of the Defiler so that the Fallen Hero can destroy it, preventing it from ever falling into the wrong hands.
Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris wants you to collect 30 Gahz'ridian Ornaments.
Kill 7 Young Nightsabers and 4 Young Thistle Boars and return to Conservator Ilthalaine.
Bring the Grape Manifest to Brother Neals in Northshire Abbey.
Bring the Crate of Grimtotem Horns to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.

Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs. Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions.
Bring U'cha's Pelt to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.
Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos.
A Little Slime Goes a Long Way
Bring 10 Filled Pure Sample Jars to Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge.
Bring Malyfous Darkhammer 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essence of Fire, and 4 Star Rubies. You will also need to turn in your Unfired Plate Gauntlets.
Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.
Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.
Place the Relic Bundle at the Darrowshire town square.
Deliver the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.
Read Warosh's Scroll. Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.
Bring the Befouled Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items:
Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.
When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent

Travel to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's Hope. Destroy 8 Scourge Structures by using Smokey's Special Compound at the Mark of Detonation planted inside each building. Smokey has had the Ziggurats and Slaughterhouses marked.
Travel to the Icewing Caverns located southwest of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley and recover the Stormpike Banner. Return the Stormpike Banner to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.
Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary.
Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.
According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Armguards
Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker Primal Hakkari Bindings. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Collect 200 Silithid Carapace Fragments and return to Baristolth.
Collect 200 Silithid Carapace Fragments and return to Baristolth.
Bring 5 Large Brilliant Shards and 3 Abyssal Signets to Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.
Bring Vek'lor's Diadem, 2 Idols of Rebirth, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Bring 1 Qiraji Ceremonial Ring, 2 Obsidian Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
Deliver the Head of Ossirian the Unscarred to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Defend Nighthaven from Eranikus. Do not let Keeper Remulos perish. Do not slay Eranikus. Defend yourself. Await Tyrande.
Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Beaststalker's Bindings to Deliana in Ironforge.
Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Beaststalker's Bindings to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Give Deliana your Devout Crown and Devout Robe.
Give Mokvar your Devout Crown and Devout Robe.
Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Wildheart Boots, a Wildheart Kilt and Wildheart Spaulders.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Wildheart Boots, a Wildheart Kilt and Wildheart Spaulders.
Dirk Thunderwood at Cenarion Hold wants you to bring him Venoxis's Venom Sac and Kurinnaxx's Venom Sac.

Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreadnaught Pauldrons if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Pauldrons, 12 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 2 Arcanite Bars and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.

Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Cryptstalker Wristguards if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Wristguards, 6 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 2 Cured Rugged Hides.

Rimblat Earthshatter at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Earthshatter Spaulders if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Spaulders, 12 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 2 Arcanite Bars and 2 Mooncloth.

Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreamwalker Spaulders if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Spaulders, 12 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 5 Cured Rugged Hides and 1 Nexus Crystal.

Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Shoulderpads of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Shoulderpads, 12 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Mooncloth and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.
The Savage Guard - Arcanum of Protection
Zanza the Restless in Zul'Gurub wants an Arcanum of Protection.
The Savage Guard - Arcanum of Rapidity
Zanza the Restless in Zul'Gurub wants an Arcanum of Rapidity.
The Savage Guard - Arcanum of Focus
Zanza the Restless in Zul'Gurub wants an Arcanum of Focus.

For 75 Insignias of the Dawn and 75 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

For 45 Insignias of the Dawn and 45 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
Epic Armaments of Battle - Exalted Amongst the Dawn
For 27 Insignias of the Dawn and 27 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants you to bring him 1 Frozen Rune, 1 Blue Sapphire and 1 Arcanite Bar.
Return the Flame of Orgrimmar to the Festival Loremaster.
Return the Flame of Thunder Bluff to the Festival Loremaster.
Return the Flame of the Undercity to the Festival Loremaster.
Return the Flame of Stormwind to the Festival Talespinner.
Return the Flame of Ironforge to the Festival Talespinner.
Return the Flame of Darnassus to the Festival Talespinner.
Visit the bonfires within Ashenvale, the Barrens, Darkshore, and Stonetalon Mountains, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
Flickering Flames in the Eastern Kingdoms
Visit the bonfires within Hillsbrad Foothills, Silverpine Forest, Westfall, and the Wetlands, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
Visit the Midsummer camps located in Azshara, Silithus, Un'Goro Crater, and Winterspring, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
